column1: # The run-status vocabulary: one definition for the name every component writes
# into an artifact's `status=` field, and for the names that mean the same thing
#   kind=emitted  the runner writes this name.
#   kind=alias    some other component writes this name; `canonical` names the
#                 emitted status it means. `canonical` is `-` for a gate-only
#                 status: a name the conversion gate writes about its own verdict
# `#` lines and blank lines are comments. Parse and assert in
# crates/autospec-core/src/run_status.rs; the vocabulary is read from this file by
# `include_str!`, so a consumer's list cannot silently disagree with it.
